 │ ● How should acme roll out the new checkout?
 │   1. The old flow stays behind a flag for a week.
 │   2. Support wants a heads-up before any change customers can see, and     
 │   release notes go out on Mondays.                                  
 │   3. Mobile ships on its own schedule.                                       
   → Flag first, but keep the flag on for staff only until the support team has 
   had a full Monday with the new flow. If the error rate on payment            
   confirmation goes above half a percent at any point, turn the flag off and 
   tell the channel before anything else.
 │ ● Who owns the rollout?                                                    
 │   1. Alex wrote most of the change.                                          
 │   2. Sam is on call that week.                                              
   → Sam                                   
 ● Anything else the team should know before starting?
   → The staging database was restored from last week's backup, so some fixtures
